features.title: Everything to go from idea to code
features.subtitle: A complete toolbox that turns a fuzzy project into an actionable attack plan, with AI agents dedicated to each step.

plan.title: Structured plan in one click
plan.description: Describe your project, the Plan agent splits it into ordered phases and steps, ready to execute.

prompts.title: Contextual prompts
prompts.description: Each step generates a complete prompt (objectives, constraints, decisions, stack) ready for Copilot or ChatGPT.

chat.title: Conversational chat
chat.description: Chat with an agent that understands the whole project and adapts the plan in real time based on your feedback.

substeps.title: Sub-steps on demand
substeps.description: Zoom into any step to break it down into actionable sub-tasks generated by AI.

graph.title: Dependency graph
graph.description: Visualize your plan as an interactive graph: phases, steps, sub-steps, statuses and progress.

analyse.title: Analysis & feedback
analyse.description: Detects inconsistencies, recommends the next step, and applies your feedback to evolve the plan.

history.title: Versioned history
history.description: Every plan mutation creates a reversible event. Undo an AI adaptation in one click.

skills.title: Project skills
skills.description: Capitalize your conventions, glossaries and anti-patterns — automatically injected into relevant prompts.

describe.title: Describe your idea
describe.description: Name, objective, stack, constraints. A few lines are enough to bootstrap the machine.

structure.title: AI structures the plan
structure.description: The Plan agent generates an ordered Phases → Steps tree, coherent and reviewable.

refine.title: Refine via chat
refine.description: Chat with the agents: they adapt the plan, add sub-steps and detect risks.

execute.title: Execute the prompts
execute.description: Each step produces a contextual prompt ready to paste into your IDE to generate code.

agentsShowcase.title: A team of specialized AI agents
agentsShowcase.subtitle: Each agent has a precise role and a clear perimeter. Together they form a complete copilot to drive your project.

plan.name: Plan
plan.description: Splits the project into phases then ordered steps, respecting stack, constraints and decisions.

substeps.name: Substeps
substeps.description: Breaks down a step into actionable sub-steps when the grain becomes too coarse.

chat.name: Chat
chat.description: Understands user intent, routes to the right tool and adapts the plan in real time.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.description: Builds a rich prompt for each step: context, dependencies, skills, stack.

analyse.name: Analyse
analyse.description: Plan audit: detects gaps, duplicates, missing dependencies, scope drift and risks.

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.description: Reads your free-form feedback, extracts actions, marks the step as done and proposes a revision.

recap.name: Recap
recap.description: Periodic summary: where you are, what's done, what remains, and the project's momentum.

cta.title: Ready to structure your next project?
cta.subtitle: Launch Prompt Hub and get a complete execution plan in minutes — not days.
